scoring_justification: Arrhenius data is checked by recomputing apparent activation energy from submitted TOF vs T; the other two artifacts are scored by structural trends (monotonicity and ordering) which are robust to simulation noise.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden activation energy acceptable range (50–70 kJ/mol) and TOF magnitude bounds (0.001–1.0 s⁻¹), derived from paper Fig. 3 caption and text: 'The corresponding Ea was 60 kJ/mol' and simulated conditions in Section 2.2.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Fig. 3 and text (Section 3, Fig. 3 discussion)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper; no holdout labels needed. The bounds are set to +/−10 kJ/mol around 60 kJ/mol and one-order-of-magnitude catch-all for TOF.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These values are directly reported in the paper and are used only to validate the agent's recomputed activation energy; they are not fabricated.

outputs.description: Catalyst relative activity (c.r.a.) vs metal dispersion Dx at 323.15 K, t=0 s.
Selectivity to HANT, 4A2NT, 2A4NT at t=0 s vs Dx.
TOF of 2,4‑DNT disappearance at t=0 s for Dx=0.3 at three temperatures.

steps.target: strict decreasing c.r.a. with Dx; Dx set {0.0,0.3,0.6,0.9}; c.r.a.(Dx=0)=1.0
strict increasing selectivity_4A2NT with Dx; selectivity_4A2NT > selectivity_2A4NT at all Dx
